lines.en: Would you like to learn about ocelots?
What would you like to say?
: Hi, Kaori. Please tell me more about your newest friend.
: hello friend this new friend isn't my friend but it's still a friend and the friend is called the leopardus pardalis or ocelot and its a mammal
: it's also a cat but you can probably tell that part because of the cute face strings and cat-like catracteristics.
: I see. But how can it be little and big at the same time?
: it is two things at once because it's not a small cat but a big cat but it's small for a big cat and also big for a small cat do you get it?
: for the example this nyanfriend can grow up to 39 inches and 35 lbs that's almost 1 pound for every inch isn't that crazy it's so big small
: I guess that is a little crazy, yeah. What else can you tell me about ocelots?
: everything i know a lot and this cat in particular because it's my favorite cat and also nocturnal which means it's sleep in the sun and enjoys the moonball
: when it goes out in the dark it finds slimy and feathery and furry creatures to eat because the ocelot isn't picky just very hungry and very in the dark
: but it is also normally lonely because it likes alone time unless babies happen then they can come too
: oh i also forgot to mention the wood things in the ground make the ocelot happy because they climb but do you remember what the wood things are called friend i don't
: Trees?
: yes those the ocelot likes them it likes to climb can you climb friend we should climb a tree together i bet you're good at it your hands are so big
: but then again the nyanfriend in the picture has no hands just claws and that makes the climb easy i wish we had claws that would be fun
: Yeah, same. Thanks again for teaching me all of this, Kaori. I really appreciate it.
: wait i have more facts to tell you so you can know more facts
: Oh, sorry.
: the ocelot lives in many places but never chile so you have to remember that if you go to chile you won't find any ocelots
: and since the ocelot is a cat it's like the other cats and can make ocespring happen as early as fifteen months imagine being a mothermom that young wow glad i'm not a cat
: I think you'd make a good cat, Kaori.
: nyaaaaaaan
: i did it i made the cat noise but i did it with letters so there was no sound and now i am just sadness
: Well, you can meow for me in person the next time I see you.
: okay and then we can climb a tree goodbye friend i will practice my cat noises and jumping i have been jumping a lot lately it's very fun
: I'm sure it is, Kaori. I'll talk to you later.
